## Kathlin (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 NG Large magical beast  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +8  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, -1 size)  

**hp** 34 (4d10+12)  

**Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +2  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 50 ft.  

**Melee** 4 hooves +7 (1d6+4), bite +7 (1d4+4)  

**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 15, **Con** 17, **Int** 5, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 8  

**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 21 (29 vs. trip)  

**Feats** Endurance, Run  

**Skills** Perception +8  

**Languages** Common, Sylvan (cannot speak)  

**SQ** great endurance  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Great Endurance (Ex)** A kathlin gains a +4 bonus to Constitution checks made to continue running. This bonus stacks with the bonus to Constitution checks the kathlin gains from the Endurance feat.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate plains  

**Organization** solitary or herd (4-13)  

**Treasure** none
